Loona Salary & Tax Calculators by Loona Automation
Free gratuity, end-of-service, net salary and income tax calculators for the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the Netherlands, Germany, Spain and Pakistan. All calculators are free with no sign-up, run 100% client-side in the visitor's browser (no data leaves the device), and are built on formulas sourced from official labour and tax law, with the source and last-verified date shown on each page. Results are estimates, not tax or legal advice.

https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/ — Homepage: index of all Loona salary, gratuity and tax calculators for the Gulf and Europe, with guides.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/uae-gratuity-calculator/ — UAE Gratuity Calculator: end-of-service gratuity under Article 51 of Federal Decree-Law 33/2021 (21 days of basic wage per year for the first 5 years, 30 days after, capped at two years' wage; resignation does not reduce it).
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/saudi-end-of-service-calculator/ — Saudi End of Service Calculator: EOSB award under Articles 84-85 of the Saudi Labour Law (half a month's wage per year for the first 5 years, a full month after; resignation scale of 0, one third, two thirds or full).
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/netherlands-salary-calculator/ — Netherlands Salary Calculator: gross-to-net for 2026 with Box 1 tax, general and labour tax credits, 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling (salary norm and 2027 change to 27% included).
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/pakistan-salary-tax-calculator/ — Pakistan Salary Tax Calculator: salary income tax on the Finance Act 2026 slabs for Tax Year 2026-27 (salaried surcharge abolished), with the 2025-26 table as a selector.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/germany-salary-calculator/ — Germany Gross-to-Net Calculator: brutto to netto in English using the exact statutory tariff of section 32a EStG (2026), tax classes including splitting for class III, solidarity surcharge, church tax and all four employee social contributions.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/uae-final-settlement-calculator/ — UAE Final Settlement Calculator: gratuity under Article 51 plus unused annual-leave pay on the basic wage and notice-period pay on the full wage, itemised; the leave and notice bases are labelled contract-dependent.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/saudi-salary-calculator/ — Saudi Salary Calculator (GOSI net pay): no income tax; GOSI employee deduction for Saudi nationals only (9.75% old system; 10.75% new system from 1 July 2026) on basic plus housing, floored at SAR 1,500 and capped at SAR 45,000; expats 0%.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/qatar-gratuity-calculator/ — Qatar Gratuity Calculator: Article 54 of Labour Law 14/2004 — gratuity as agreed in the contract with a legal floor of 21 days of basic wage per year; input for a better contract rate; no resignation reduction.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/kuwait-indemnity-calculator/ — Kuwait Indemnity Calculator: Articles 51-53 of Labour Law 6/2010 for monthly-paid staff — 15 days per year for five years at the divide-by-26 daily rate, one full month per year after, Article 53 resignation scale, 18-month cap; the wage-basis and post-year-5 method choices are disclosed on the page.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/oman-gratuity-calculator/ — Oman Gratuity Calculator: Article 61 of RD 53/2023 — one month of basic wage per year for service from 1 August 2023, old-law rates (15 days per year for the first three years, then one month) for earlier service, all on the last basic wage.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/bahrain-indemnity-calculator/ — Bahrain Indemnity Calculator: leaving indemnity under Article 116 of Legislative Decree 36/2012 for workers outside social insurance — half a month per year for the first three years, one month per year after, on basic wage plus social allowance; no cap.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/gcc-gratuity-comparison-calculator/ — GCC Gratuity Comparison Calculator: one salary and service period run through all six Gulf end-of-service formulas (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain) side by side, with employer-ended and resignation variants.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/netherlands-30-percent-ruling-calculator/ — Netherlands 30% Ruling Calculator: net pay with and without the ruling on the 2026 Box 1 engine, the salary-norm limit (EUR 48,013 / EUR 36,497) and EUR 262,000 cap applied, the yearly benefit, and a 2027 preview at 27% using 2026 norms (disclosed).
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/netherlands-30-percent-ruling-eligibility-checker/ — 30% Ruling Eligibility Checker: test-by-test check of the 2026 conditions — salary norm (with reduced-allowance outcome), 150 km rule, recruitment from abroad, Dutch withholding employer; researchers exempt from the salary test.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/netherlands-holiday-allowance-calculator/ — Netherlands Holiday Allowance Calculator: the statutory 8% vakantiegeld and its special-rate (bijzonder tarief) tax, computed as the marginal tax on the allowance including tax-credit phase-out, with a 30% ruling option.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/germany-tax-class-comparison-calculator/ — Germany Tax Class Comparison Calculator: the same gross salary in Steuerklassen I-VI using the exact section 32a EStG 2026 tariff (class III via statutory splitting), plus combined III/V versus IV/IV couple totals.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/spain-salary-calculator/ — Spain Net Salary Calculator: gross-to-net with 6.50% employee social security on the capped contribution base (EUR 61,214.40) and IRPF on the standard scale with the EUR 5,550 personal minimum; regional-scale warning on the page; 12 or 14 payments.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/spain-beckham-law-calculator/ — Beckham Law Calculator: Spain's Article 93 impatriate regime — flat 24% up to EUR 600,000 (47% above) versus the standard IRPF scale on the same salary, with the one-year and full six-year savings; shows when the standard scale wins.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/pakistan-freelancer-tax-calculator/ — Pakistan Freelancer Tax Calculator: Section 154A final tax on IT-export remittances — 0.25% PSEB-registered, 1% unregistered (non-filer doubling flagged as practitioner-sourced) — compared with the normal non-salaried First Schedule slabs including the 10% surcharge above Rs 10 million.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/zakat-calculator/ — Zakat Calculator: 2.5% on net zakatable wealth (gold and silver valued from user-entered per-tola rates with a karat adjustment, plus cash, business stock and receivables, minus debts due) with the gold/silver nisab check; 1 tola = 11.664 g.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/guides/how-uae-gratuity-is-calculated.html — Guide: how UAE gratuity is calculated under Article 51, with two worked examples, the February 2022 abolition of resignation reductions, and the DIFC/ADGM exceptions.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/guides/saudi-end-of-service-benefits-guide.html — Guide: Saudi end of service benefits under Articles 84 and 85, the resignation-scale table, a worked example, and a note on GOSI (employee deductions apply to Saudi nationals only).
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/guides/netherlands-30-percent-ruling-explained.html — Guide: the Netherlands 30% ruling explained — who qualifies, the 2026 salary norms (EUR 48,013 standard; EUR 36,497 for under-30s with a master's degree), a worked benefit example, and the drop to 27% from 1 January 2027.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/guides/pakistan-salary-tax-2026-27-guide.html — Guide: Pakistan salary tax for 2026-27 — the full Finance Act 2026 slab table, worked examples at Rs 100,000 and Rs 250,000 per month, the abolition of the salaried surcharge, and a section 154A note for freelancers and IT exporters.
https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-salary-calculators/guides/germany-gross-to-net-explained.html — Guide: Germany gross to net explained in English — the six tax classes, the four social contributions with 2026 rates and ceilings, the solidarity surcharge and church tax, and a worked EUR 60,000 example.
